NAMAZ OF IMAM ZAYN AL-’ABIDIN (A)

This prayer consists of four units in each of which Surah al-Faatehah is recited once while Surah al-Tawheed is repeated one hundred times. After the namaz recite the dua of Imam Zayn Al Abidin (a.s.):
